subject: Invoice reminders and payment follow-up
message: Can you automate reminders for overdue invoices and give our team a weekly list of clients who still have not paid? We use Stripe exports and a shared Google Sheet.

subject: Appointment CSV dashboard
message: We need a simple dashboard that pulls appointment CSV files, flags missed follow-ups, and sends a weekly summary to the office manager.

subject: Ticket triage backlog
message: Our support queue is getting noisy. We want requests tagged by urgency, billing, login problems, and feature requests before an agent touches them.

subject: CRM lead qualification
message: Can you help us score new leads, draft the first reply, and route qualified prospects to HubSpot? We mostly get web form submissions.

subject: Operations report cleanup
message: Every Friday we combine CSV files from three vendors and manually write a summary. We want a cleaner report with exceptions and next actions.
